items.title: Marilyn Crispell interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 21, 2022
items.q: I remember one particular instance of playing a concert with my whole heart... I was playing with Braxton and everything

ctx.x: Well I’m glad you said that because I hoped to be corrected.

Yeah, some of the most fun I’ve ever had playing. I mean Anthony is an amazing chess player. I think he even used to make a living playing chess in Washington Square Park. I might have dreamed that up but I think that’s true. And playing his music, it was a challenge but it was a fun challenge, you know? And you definitely had to be on your toes all the time. But there was a lot of joy and humor and it was really, I think when we were — at least speaking for myself — when we were doing this we weren’t thinking oh…
Well when you stood up to take a bow you were all smiling.
